items.title: Why some trees might fall during extreme heat
items.description: Scientists are studying how trees respond to hotter, drier conditions caused by climate change.

sections.title: Beyond Climate — Other Major EU News

items.title: Europe heat wave: 1,000 excess deaths recorded in France
items.description: The French Health Ministry noted a sharp increase in deaths especially in areas hit hardest by the heat wave. Germany is meanwhile breaking for another potentially record-breaking day. Follow DW for the latest.

sections.title: Beyond Climate & EU — World News Highlights

items.title: Fact check: As Europe bakes, should you trust your sunscreen?
items.description: As a heat wave sweeps across Europe, claims are resurfacing online questioning whether sunscreen is safe or linked to skin cancer risk.

items.title: New Caledonia heads to polls in vote delayed since 2024
items.description: Security has been high at polling stations as the South Pacific archipelago holds its first provincial elections since 2019. The vote in the French territory was originally set for 2024 but was delayed by violent unrest.

items.title: Heatwave breaks records in Germany, Denmark and Czech Republic
items.description: An estimated 150 million people have been experiencing temperatures of over 35C across Europe.

items.title: Families calling out to loved ones trapped in rubble by Venezuela quakes
items.description: In La Guaira, desperate families keep vigil at buildings where they fear their relatives are trapped, but face an impossible task to move heavy debris.

items.title: In Caracas, this feels like the hardest moment in Venezuela's modern history
items.description: Rescue teams are working ceaselessly to reach those trapped under rubble. But as hope fades, anger is growing.
